title: Niha Kakkar Songs
meta_description: Listen to the biggest and best ever collection of Neha Kakkar's hit songs
full_description: Listen to the biggest and best ever collection of Neha Kakkar's hit songs If you are a fan of Neha Kakkar songs, this is a must-have app. You can enjoy the largest collection of her songs in various playlists. You can simply search for your favorite songs or select their songs from various playlists already created for you - Application features: • It works without the net. • Stylish design that is easy to use. • You can automatically switch between songs. • The feature of random transition between songs. • The feature of re-listening one song or the songs of an entire package. • Automatic when a call is received and continue listening as soon as the call ends. • High quality when listening. • You can listen to songs in the background and use your other applications. • Small in size and not a large place in the device.Notice: All content in this application is not our trademark.
